values.note: Every site has water and electric; 3 full-hookup sites add sewer. The park does not state the amperage.

hookups.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/andrew-jackson/camping ('Each site has individual water and electrical hookups'; 'Full Hookup Sites with Elec, Water, Sewer: 3'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 22 water/electric and 3 full-hookup sites: five paved sites take RVs up to 36 ft, the 20 gravel sites up to 30 ft.

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/andrew-jackson/camping ('Five paved sites accommodate RVs up to 36 feet, while 20 gravel sites accommodate RVs up to 30 feet'; 22 standard + 3 full hookup), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/andrew-jackson/camping ('restrooms with hot showers'; Dump Station: Yes; 'No Wifi Available'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; per AWH's firsthand report on the agency row, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights per site (42 of 49 cumulative). Same-day reservations go through the park. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/andrew-jackson/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; same-day via the park) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/andrew-jackson/campsites (policies: 'Reservations may be made up to 13 months in advance', 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 nights per site', check-in 2:00 p.m.), read 2026-10-21; single-night phone waiver from the state:SC row's AWH firsthand note

note: Single loop beside the park's 18-acre lake. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 25 sites (22 W/E + 3 full hookup), RVs to 36 ft (paved) / 30 ft (gravel), showers, dump; added no Wi-Fi; booking confirmed with the 13-month window, 2-night minimum (AWH phone waiver) and 14-night max, now on the entry.
